name: Wyckoff accumulation / distribution: the range after a decline resolves up, after a rise down
why: A 20-session trading range after a decline is where large operators absorb the supply of the late sellers (accumulation) before marking price up; after a rise it is distribution before the markdown. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_wyckoff_phases.md).
